summary: Creates metaballs and meta-superquadric implicit surfaces whose fields can fuse, model organic blobs, or act as force fields for other SOP workflows.

key_params.name: modifybounds
key_params.note: Use input bounds; only available when an input is connected.

common_gotchas: Implicit fields can fuse when metaballs are close together.
Conversion/display detail can become expensive with dense metaball surfaces.
key_concepts: Metaball SOP creates metaballs and meta-superquadrics as implicit density fields.
Nearby metaballs fuse or reshape each other when their densities combine.
Radius, weight, kernel, and exponent controls define field shape and falloff.
Normals should exist before polygon conversion when better converted shading is needed.
